name: Issue Tracker
description: The triage queue in front of your GitHub issues. Agents you pick prioritise the queue, draft follow-up questions for reporters and summarise issues; what they want to change waits as a proposal until you apply it. Implementing an issue starts an agent on it in a worktree of its own, asked to open a pull request that closes it.

permissions.reason: To find the project of each repository it follows, and run its agents in that project.
To list and read the open issues of the repositories it follows.
Only when you apply a proposal: to set an issue's priority labels and post its follow-up or summary comment. Nothing is written before you apply.
Each triage action, and each piece of implementing work, is a thread of the agent you chose for it.
Its triage agents read the queue and report their proposals through tools of this plugin.

settings.label: Repositories
settings.description: owner/name of each repository whose issues are the queue. Empty follows every GitHub project on this MC. Implementing needs a checkout of the repository as a project.

settings.label: Only issues labelled
settings.description: Empty to follow every open issue.

settings.label: Agent that prioritises
settings.description: {"provider", "model", "modelOptions", "runtimeMode"}: the agent instance, its model (empty for its default), the model's options such as {"effort": "high"}, and its access. It only reads and reports.

settings.label: Prioritising prompt
settings.description: {{repository}}, {{issues}}, {{count}} and {{today}} are filled in. How to report is added after it.

settings.label: Agent that asks for follow-up
settings.description: As the prioritising agent, for the threads that draft a follow-up comment on one issue.

settings.label: Follow-up prompt
settings.description: {{repository}}, {{number}}, {{title}}, {{author}}, {{body}}, {{labels}}, {{url}} and {{today}} are filled in. How to report is added after it.

settings.label: Agent that summarises
settings.description: As the prioritising agent, for the threads that summarise one issue.

settings.label: Summarising prompt
settings.description: {{repository}}, {{number}}, {{title}}, {{author}}, {{body}}, {{labels}}, {{url}}, {{others}} and {{today}} are filled in. How to report is added after it.

settings.label: Agent that implements
settings.description: As the prioritising agent, for the threads that implement an issue. It works in a new worktree of the issue's project.

settings.label: Implementing prompt
